build_node_to_edge_wigner_permute: build a Triton kernel wrapper that permutes node features to edges using Wigner D-matrices
build_permute_wigner_inv_edge_to_node: build a Triton kernel wrapper that permutes edge features back to nodes using inverse Wigner D-matrices
build_bwd_dx_node_to_edge: build a backward kernel wrapper that computes per-edge gradients for the node-to-edge Wigner permutation
build_bwd_dx_edge_to_node: build a backward kernel wrapper that computes input gradients for the edge-to-node Wigner permutation
build_bwd_dw_edge_to_node: build a backward kernel wrapper that computes Wigner matrix gradients via dy @ x_l transpose
